Hi, I am Julia. I am a physical therapist, health services researcher, and public health professional with more than 30 years of experience at the intersection of academia, rehabilitation, implementation science, and chronic disease prevention.

I am a faculty member with the [Clinical Research PhD Program](https://accelerated.uj.edu/academics/programs/clinical-research/){target="_blank"} at the University of Jamestown.

I also engage in public health work as a subject matter expert working with the [National Association of Chronic Disease Directors](https://chronicdisease.org){target="_blank"}. My public health work focuses on building models for community-clinical partnerships that improve outcomes for people living with arthritis, fall risk, and other chronic conditions.
